user.title: NiimBridge
user.description: Choose the Niimbot printer and label settings. Sizes are landscape; use rotation to match how your printer feeds labels (D110 usually needs 90).

data.qr_percent: QR code size (% of label height)

webhook.title: HomeBox webhook
webhook.description:
Set this in HomeBox so it posts each label here:

`{command}`

You can also POST JSON (`name`, `asset_id`, `location`, `url`) to the webhook URL:

`{webhook_url}`

data.qr_percent: QR code size (% of label height)

print_label.name: Print label
print_label.description: Render the standard item label and print it on the Niimbot printer.

config_entry_id.name: Bridge
config_entry_id.description: Required only with more than one bridge.

name.name: Name
name.description: Item name; floor and area words are removed from it. Optional if asset_id is set.

asset_id.name: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Shown in a small monospace font above the floor and area.

location.name: Location
location.description: Alternative to floor/area: a 'Floor | Area' or 'Floor / Area' string is split automatically.

url.name: URL
url.description: Encoded in the QR code (falls back to asset ID, then name).

preview_only.name: Preview only
preview_only.description: Render the preview image without printing.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Shown with the area as 'floor | area'.

area.name: Area
area.description: Shown with the floor as 'floor | area'.
